text_block_list.text:
Success at the February Stakes marks
the first win
of Смарт Фалкон's victory
declaration.

Her smooth start causes quite a stir
around her,
yet she herself is
uncharacteristically coolheaded.

Our next planned race is the Teio Sho in
June.
Without letting herself get carried
away, Smart
Falcon focuses on her next
victory.
